title: fix(metadata-protocol): the layered read of a form view naming a field its object lacks carries the form-field-unknown warning
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ811zUetuVLmmG85oB1QY7WM)_

Fixes #29435
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：分层读取（`GET /api/v1/meta/view/NAME?layers=true`）现在对 `effective` 跑与单项读取相同的表单布局检查，表单视图引用对象不存在的字段时，`_diagnostics.warnings` 带上 `form-field-unknown` 警告。
- 为什么改：Studio 的界面栏目和元数据编辑器在没有草稿时读分层结果；已发布、无草稿的表单视图此前显示 `valid: true`，作者看不到警告，字段在运行时被静默跳过。
- 风险与回滚：只追加警告，`valid` 仍取 schema 的结论；非 view 类型原样返回。回滚即还原本 PR，无迁移。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts` 中 `_diagnostics` 的计算（约 L510），以及测试文件末尾的 #29435 一节。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.form-layout-diagnostics.test.ts`，预期 12 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的：无,席位落地

## What changes

`getMetaItemLayered` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts`) computed `_diagnostics` with `computeMetadataDiagnostics(request.type, effective)` alone, which is schema-only. `getMetaItem` adds the lint's form-layout warnings through `withFormLayoutWarnings` (#29196, #29309). So a published form view whose section names `no_such_field` read `{ valid: true }` on the layered read while the single-item read of the same body warned.

The layered read now runs `withFormLayoutWarnings` on `effective`, with the schema verdict as the prior `_diagnostics`. The object lookup is the same one `getMetaItem` uses (`host.engine.registry.getObject`, the served object with its extensions folded on). It covers `form-field-unknown` and `form-section-group-unknown`, at the same item-relative paths. Warnings only, so `valid` stays the schema's answer. A non-view type, or a body that is not a record, gets back exactly the schema verdict.

The pass runs before redaction and before `servedLockState`, where the schema verdict already ran, so it judges the same raw `effective` body.

Execution-context exemption: `serveFormLayout` skips the pass on the execution face (`opts.face === 'execution'`). `getMetaItemLayered` has no face parameter and no execution caller; it is the `?layers=true` authoring read. So there is no execution leg to exempt, and the pass runs unconditionally. Stated in the code comment.

Files (3, +84 / -2):

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts`: the pass, one import.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.form-layout-diagnostics.test.ts`: a new `describe` at the end, plus `getItem: () => undefined` on the stub registry (the layered read's code-layer lookup; no package ships these views). The pins sit in the same file as the #29196 pins rather than a new file beside it, so they reuse its stub engine instead of copying 150 lines of harness.
- `.changeset/29435-layered-read-form-layout-warnings.md`: patch for `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`.

No `packages/spec` hunk. The response shape is unchanged: `_diagnostics.warnings` already exists on `MetadataDiagnostics`.

## Tests

Two new tests in `protocol.form-layout-diagnostics.test.ts`:

1. A published form view naming `no_such_field`: `getMetaItemLayered(...)._diagnostics` equals `{ valid: true, warnings: [{ path: 'config.sections.0.fields.1', message }] }`, with the message taken from `validateFormLayout` run in the test, and equals `getMetaItem`'s `item._diagnostics` for the same item.
2. Control: a published form naming only real fields, `region__c` (an extension field) among them, reads exactly `{ valid: true }`.

Red first on `7dae3b3c` (fix not applied): test 1 failed with `expected { valid: true } to deeply equal { valid: true, warnings: [ … ] }`, test 2 passed. With the fix: 12/12.

Ablation (`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, fix committed first at `7349766e`): the anchor `const _diagnostics = effective !== null && typeof effective === 'object'` was replaced with `false && …` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `fdc7bda8` → `1bc73586`). Test 1 red, 11 green. Restored: blob equals HEAD `fdc7bda8`, `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports `./protocol.js` from `src`, so no `dist/` leg applies.

## Acceptance notes

- The card asks for the pins "beside" `protocol.form-layout-diagnostics.test.ts`; they are inside it, for the harness reason above.
- No out-of-scope finding.
